WITH weight_findings AS (
    SELECT 
        f.shipment_id,
        f.rule_id,
        f.severity,
        f.status
    FROM findings f
    WHERE f.rule_id IN ('X3', 'X4')
),
shipment_sellers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        s.id AS shipment_id,
        s.reference,
        i.seller_id,
        i.seller_name
    FROM shipments s
    JOIN invoices i ON s.id = i.shipment_id
)
SELECT 
    ss.seller_name,
    COUNT(wf.shipment_id) AS weight_findings_count
FROM weight_findings wf
JOIN shipment_sellers ss ON wf.shipment_id = ss.shipment_id
GROUP BY ss.seller_name
ORDER BY weight_findings_count DESC, ss.seller_name ASC
output.explanation: Returns the suppliers with the highest number of weight-related findings (rules X3 and X4) across all shipments, ordered by count descending.
